notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch only - curl with a real-browser User-Agent against a Shopify storefront; robots.txt (checked first) has a blanket 'User-agent: *' disallow list that does not block /collections pages or name any Claude/Anthropic bot, so all tiers were permitted, but tier (a) worked cleanly (HTTP 200 on every request) and no block was ever hit, so tiers (b)/(c) were not needed. TREE: built the mega-menu from the SSR nav block in the homepage HTML (id=Linklist-main-menu-1, 3 levels deep), then for every level-3 leaf fetched its own collection page and read its in-page 'shop by category' swiper strip (swiper-container ... main-navigation) to find further child subcategories not present in the mega-menu (e.g. Bedroom Decor, Bathroom Decor, Curtains, Throw Pillows & Throw Blankets, Kitchen Decor, Junior, Baby each expose deeper children this way). Confirmed leaf vs parent by checking whether a page's own swiper strip lists itself+siblings (leaf) or genuinely different child collections (parent with subcategories, in which case the parent's own URL/qty was dropped per the parent-category-URL rule and only children recorded). Cross-checked the full /collections.json list (375 handles) as the sitemap-equivalent; the large majority are promotional/sale/style/color merchandising collections (e.g. 'Black Friday Furniture Sale', 'Corduroy', 'Earth tones') or stale orphaned collections and were excluded as non-navigational per the View-All/Collections rule. Verified this for several Junior/Nursery-prefixed handles seen in collections.json but absent from any live nav strip (junior-storage-baskets, junior-storage-baskets-and-rugs, junior-curtains, junior-bedding, junior-rugs, junior-bedding-throw-blankets/-and-throw-blankets, nursery-storage-baskets, nursery-storage-baskets-and-rugs, nursery-curtains, nursery-rugs) by pulling each one's /products.json - every one of them returned 0 products, confirming they are dead/legacy collections and correctly excluded. QTY: exact rendered value of the theme.collection.products_count JS variable embedded in each collection page's SSR HTML (the live storefront's own product count for that exact collection, same value the visible 'N products' UI text is bound to) - never estimated or paginated/counted manually. EXCLUDED: Furniture, Lighting, Wall Decor/Mirrors, Greenery & Florals, Home Fragrances, Gift Card, Kitchen & Dining dinnerware/accessories, Decor (candles/vases/decorative objects), Bathroom Furniture/Wall Decor, Junior/Nursery Wall Decor & Mirrors/Lighting/Bedroom Furniture/Decorative Accessories, Nursery Decor - all per each rule file's own boundary sections. Window Blinds & Shades (17 products, /collections/window-blinds-and-shades) was checked product-by-product and excluded from Textile: majority are non-fabric (faux wood, PVC, vinyl roller shades) with only a minority genuinely fabric (sheer shades), and the category itself is not per-material splittable without fabricating a sub-count, so the whole node was left out per the material/primary-type rule. Curtain Accessories & Hardware excluded as hardware. Bathroom Accessories (7 products: storage trays/caddy mixed with soap dispenser/tumbler/toilet brush) and Junior Decorative Accessories (32 products, contains several fabric hampers mixed with toys/LED decor/vases) were checked product-by-product and excluded in full from Storage: each is a mixed catch-all collection with no dedicated storage-only subcategory URL, and the majority of each collection's products are non-storage, so including the whole node would misrepresent the category per the primary-purpose rule; no clean sub-URL exists to isolate just the storage items. DUPLICATE HANDLED: /collections/storage-and-baskets and /collections/storage-baskets-and-hampers were verified via /products.json to contain the exact same 37 product handles (same underlying Shopify collection reachable via two nav paths: Decor & Pillows > Storage & Baskets, and Bed & Bath > Bathroom Decor > Storage Baskets & Hampers) - kept once under Decor & Pillows > Storage & Baskets and dropped the Bathroom Decor duplicate per the duplicate-record rule; Bathroom Decor was consequently dropped from storage_rows entirely since it had no other storage children. Crib Bedding & Throws (Baby > Crib Bedding & Throws) recorded with qty=0 - the collection page's own theme.collection.products_count explicitly reads 0, a genuine currently-empty category, not an estimate.
